answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The trellis lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the beacon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
